nodes.title: Fast mode: Sol sparse attention (un-bypass + set steps to 2)
Read me
widgets_values:
# Open-H3 Face Region: prompt to 2K in one go
**Prompt -> 768p MiniMax H3 draft -> 2560x1440 regenerate that keeps the faces and the lip sync.** By [@BennyDaBall_OG](https://x.com/BennyDaBall_OG).

**How it works:** NVIDIA's Open-H3-Regenerate-2K re-draws the upscaled draft from 91% noise, which adds detail but recasts the actors. Here an automatic face mask (OpenCV YuNet) makes **faces start the 2K pass at 50% noise** while everything else still gets the full 91% regenerate. The draft's own audio is held clean so the mouths keep talking. Only the 2K refiner LoRA, no Turbo or Sharp.

**Use:** write your prompt in node 1 (dialogue in `<d>[English] ... </d>` is spoken with lip sync), set a draft seed, queue. You get the 768p draft and the 2K video (about 3 min for the 2K pass on an RTX 5090).

**Knobs:** Face mask `face_strength` 0.55 = faces start at 0.50 (higher = more new face texture, less likeness). `extra_boxes` = x0,y0,x1,y1 in 768p draft pixels to protect a pet or prop. **Fast mode:** un-bypass the Sol sparse attention node and set the 2K steps to 2 (about 70 s, same face match, a bit less detail).

**Needs:** [ComfyUI-Open-H3-FaceRegion](https://github.com/BennyDaBall930/ComfyUI-Open-H3-FaceRegion), [rdh9616/ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate](https://github.com/rdh9616/ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate), [LBH-123-AI latent upscaler](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler). Models download from the loader nodes.
